title: Unbounded parallel fan-out exhausts the worker pool as the fan-out width grows
source_note: Failure pattern (a request that fans out into N parallel subrequests, where N grew with data until the fan-out saturated the caller's worker pool) reflects concurrency guidance in the AWS Builders' Library. All services, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~15:10 UTC the dashboard API is timing out for users with large accounts. Small accounts are fine. No deploys today. Worker utilization on dashboard-api is maxed.

signal_lines.msg: worker pool utilisation 88%; some requests fanning out to 400+ parallel widget-service calls
largest accounts now have 600+ widgets; one dashboard render holds 600 worker slots at once
worker pool exhausted (size=512); new dashboard requests queued then timing out
widget-service itself is healthy; p95 12ms; load is just very spiky from dashboard-api fan-out
operator capped fan-out concurrency at 20 per request; worker pool recovering

ground_truth.root_cause: dashboard-api renders a dashboard by fanning out one parallel call to widget-service per widget, with no cap on concurrency. As the largest accounts accumulated widgets (now 600+), a single dashboard render for one of those accounts holds hundreds of worker-pool slots at once. Enough concurrent large-account renders exhausted the 512-slot worker pool, so new requests queued and timed out. widget-service is healthy - the problem is the un-bounded fan-out width on the caller, which crossed a threshold as data grew. Recovery required capping per-request fan-out concurrency.
evidence_path: dashboard-api WARN: requests fanning out to 400+ parallel widget-service calls; worker utilisation 88%
dashboard-api WARN: largest accounts now have 600+ widgets; one render holds 600 worker slots
dashboard-api ERROR: worker pool exhausted (size=512); new requests queue then time out
widget-service confirmed healthy (p95 12ms) - the load is spiky fan-out, not a widget-service problem
recovery after fan-out concurrency is capped at 20 per request
ground_truth.fix: Cap per-request fan-out concurrency and batch the widget calls (done). Add a bounded worker pool per fan-out stage, page or lazy-load widgets for very large dashboards, and alert on fan-out width.
